diagram_math_checks.objects: Z=Z(U(g)); R=S(h) localized at 0; source Z tensor_C R; middle R tensor_{R^W} R; target E_R=End_{g tensor R}(P_R).
diagram_math_checks.justification: The item Given and [F1], and the Statement of lem-the-central-action-on-the-deformed-antidominant-projective, use exactly these objects and the right-R algebra structure.

diagram_math_checks.map: a_lambda: Z tensor_C R -> R tensor_{R^W} R sends z tensor r to sigma_lambda(HC_rho(z)) tensor r.
diagram_math_checks.domain_codomain_check: This is the explicit map of item [F1] and supplier Statement; it is not marked as an isomorphism. The source and tensor-product ordering match step 1.1.

diagram_math_checks.map: m_R: Z tensor_C R -> E_R is central multiplication, (z tensor r)(p)=r z p.
diagram_math_checks.domain_codomain_check: The center commutes with the g action and the deformation R action, so these are g tensor R-linear endomorphisms. This is the multiplication map of item [F1]/step 1.1 and supplier Statement.

diagram_math_checks.relation: phi: R tensor_{R^W} R -> E_R is an R-algebra isomorphism; phi composed with a_lambda equals m_R.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Item [F1]/step 1.1 assert both maps surjective with the same kernel. For b=a_lambda(u), define phi(b)=m_R(u); equal kernels make it well defined and injective, and surjectivity makes it onto. This is the common-kernel identification proved by the supplier in steps 7.1 and 8.1. The triangle has exactly these two paths and marks only phi with an isomorphism symbol.

diagram_math_checks.relation: After tensoring the right R factor with the residue field C (complex numbers), the middle algebra is the coinvariant algebra C and E_R specializes to End_g P(w_0 dot lambda).
diagram_math_checks.justification: The prose uses item steps 1.2–2.1 and [F2] Hom base change, consistent with supplier step 8.1. No preservation of kernels under tensoring or graded category-O lift is asserted by the figure.
